lines.text: Elisha came while Ben-hadad was sick, and the king told Hazael to take a gift and inquire of the LORD.
Hazael met Elisha with a gift of forty camel loads of every good thing from Samaria.
Elisha told Hazael to say the king would recover, though he would die, and Elisha wept over Hazael's coming evil.
Elisha said the LORD had shown him that Hazael would be king over Israel.
Hazael told the king he would recover, then next day spread a wet cloth over his face and reigned.
